baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated ع ر ض in أَعْرَضَ and عَرِيضٍ, joined to نَأَى بِجَانِبِهِ and دُعَاءٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two clauses exchange one resource, breadth: ease makes the human turn the body's breadth away and increase spatial distance, while harm converts that withdrawn breadth into expanded speech. The return to relation is vocal only after bodily relation has been refused.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's breadth away supplies the embodied withdrawal in the first clause.
Breadth opposed to length supplies the expanded scale of the final appeal and links it back to the turned side.
Distancing by one's side makes withdrawal a bodily direction rather than an unlocated attitude.
The bodily side provides the surface whose orientation enacts relational availability or refusal.
Calling that inclines another by speech turns the second clause back toward solicited relation.

changed_reading.before: The human is ungrateful in ease and verbose in distress.
changed_reading.after: Ease withdraws embodied breadth from relation; distress redeploys that same breadth as a bid for relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast between أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى and مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A whole benefaction can arrive upon the human without eliciting engagement, whereas an adverse effect need only reach him to trigger a broad output. The verse therefore diagnoses asymmetric response gain: muted reception of good and amplified response to harm.

activation_trace.role: Good condition and benefaction supply the substantial positive input that receives a muted response.
Being reached by an effect supplies the low contact threshold that activates the adverse response.
Evil or badness identifies the negative input whose mere contact is amplified.
Vocal solicitation is the amplified output produced by adverse contact.
Breadth gives the adverse output a scale absent from the response to benefaction.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts two inconsistent moods.
changed_reading.after: The verse maps a skewed human sensor-response system: good is under-registered, while harm is over-amplified.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ followed by نَأَى بِجَانِبِهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch field makes favor an accommodating place, human presence a possibility of companionship, and the side a site of adjacency. Against that semantic environment, the subject manufactures estrangement precisely when conditions invite settling and nearness; the later call attempts to recover relation only under pressure.

activation_trace.role: A place that suits its inhabitant and makes residence pleasant recasts favor as offered accommodation.
Companionship that removes estrangement supplies the relational capacity named by the human.
Side-by-side proximity supplies the adjacency that the subject actively refuses.
Distance and removal reverse the offered accommodation into self-produced estrangement.

changed_reading.before: Prosperity distracts the human from gratitude.
changed_reading.after: The human declines offered habitation and adjacency, then calls back toward the relation only when afflicted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening refusal sequence turns the focus posture into a communication topology. The audience turns away, does not receive meaning, weights its ears, and installs a barrier against an incoming call. In 41:51 the same kind of subject becomes the caller, expanding an outgoing plea only when harmed.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's breadth away anchors the focus posture that the earlier communication scene explains.
Turning away repeats the posture at the point where good news and warning are refused.
Hearing as understanding and compliance, structurally negated here, identifies the reception that withdrawal blocks.
An incoming vocal call supplies the communication direction the audience refuses.
Weight in the ear materializes impaired reception rather than mere lack of information.
Prevention of access supplies the interpersonal barrier across which later prayer must travel.
The focus call reverses the subject from resistant addressee into urgent addresser.

structural_cues: 41:4 binds turning away to non-hearing; 41:5 places coverings, ear-weight, and a barrier between an incoming caller and the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated withdrawal, calling, and blocked reception; I infer a role reversal from refusing an incoming call to emitting an outgoing one. A live alternative is that the focus call is only quantitatively long.

changed_reading.before: The broad prayer is simply the second half of an individual mood swing.
changed_reading.after: The broad prayer is outgoing traffic from someone who previously built resistance to incoming address.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heaven and earth answer address with willing approach, while the favored human answers benefaction with lateral retreat. The focus response is therefore not merely unstable; it is anti-cosmic, reversing the approach pattern modeled by creation.

activation_trace.role: Distance and withdrawal anchor the human response that is set against approach.
Coming and arrival supply the creation scene's movement toward the address.
Willing compliance makes approach a responsive orientation rather than forced motion.

structural_cues: 41:11 stages heaven and earth answering an address by coming willingly; 41:51 stages the human answering favor by moving away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two response scenes; I align their opposite directions as an evaluative analogy. The live alternative is that the creation scene establishes sovereignty without modeling human response.

changed_reading.before: The human reacts badly to changing circumstances.
changed_reading.after: The human reverses creation's willing approach: benefaction produces retreat where address should produce coming.

context_deltas.mechanism: The central call passages distinguish durable calling from crisis output. Within abiding alliance, desire and claimed request are provisioned; the exemplary caller directs others toward God and couples calling with sound action. The focus subject instead withdraws under favor and produces width without accompanying work when harmed.

activation_trace.role: Vocal solicitation anchors the crisis call whose quality is changed by the comparison.
The self's movement toward what it desires supplies the stable desire-call setting.
Claiming or requesting a due identifies a call answered inside an abiding relation.
Calling that inclines others by speech supplies the outward, other-directed call mode.
Intentional action joins speech to durable conduct rather than leaving it as emergency volume.
Soundness opposed to corruption qualifies the action paired with the exemplary call.

structural_cues: 41:31 locates fulfilled desire and request inside continuing divine alliance; 41:33 coordinates calling, doing, and avowed submission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three call configurations; I treat their differing companions as diagnostic of call quality. Alternatively, 41:51 may characterize intensity without implying absence of action.

changed_reading.before: A broad prayer is evidence of intense religious speech.
changed_reading.after: Breadth alone is exposed as compensatory volume when calling has been severed from abiding relation and sound action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The instruction to answer bad with what is better converts enmity and separation into unmediated nearness and intimate attachment. The focus human performs the inverse conversion: divine good arrives, yet nearness is converted into a turned side and distance.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction supplies the good input that should enable relational conversion.
Self-produced distance is the inverted relational result.
Doing what is good supplies the transforming response to an adverse input.
Pushing away the harmful by a better means supplies the directional conversion.
Nearness without an interval names the relation produced by the better response.
Intimate kin-like closeness intensifies the endpoint that the focus subject reverses.

structural_cues: 41:34 moves from bad input to better response to intimate proximity; 41:51 moves from benefaction to withdrawal and distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inverse input-response sequences; I infer that their opposite relational outputs illuminate each other. They may alternatively function as independent ethical and anthropological scenes.

changed_reading.before: Turning away after favor is passive neglect.
changed_reading.after: Turning away is an active anti-conversion: it turns received good into distance instead of turning adversity into proximity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The humbled earth receives descending water and answers through movement, life, and upward growth. The human receives favor upon him and answers through lateral withdrawal. The shared reception pattern makes the focus posture an ecological reversal: gift should become visible response, not evacuated relation.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction supplies the life-supporting input whose human reception is being tested.
Sideways distance supplies the human output opposed to receptive growth.
Delivering something downward supplies the earth's received gift.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material benefaction that activates the earth.
Earth and plant movement with life supplies an immediate receptive response.
Increase and rising supply the earth's outward conversion of received water.

structural_cues: Both scenes place a gift upon a recipient; 41:39 follows reception with movement and rising, while 41:51 follows it with turning and distancing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel reception-and-response sequences; I supply the ecological analogy and treat vertical growth versus lateral retreat as evaluative. The alternative is that the earth image concerns resurrection only.

changed_reading.before: The person merely fails to acknowledge a favor.
changed_reading.after: The person fails a creaturely reciprocity visible in the earth, converting life-giving reception into lateral retreat rather than responsive growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The distant-call scene gives the focus breadth an acoustic-spatial function. Ear-weight and inner blindness put the resistant hearer as if at a remote location; after favor he also makes himself distant by his side. Once harmed, his prayer must become broad or long-range to cross the remoteness his orientation produced.

activation_trace.role: Distance anchors the remoteness generated by the focus subject.
Vocal calling anchors the transmission that breadth amplifies.
Weight in the ear supplies the failed receiving end of the long-range communication.
Blindness of inner perception makes remoteness cognitive as well as spatial.
The range and distance of a voice supply the acoustic reach activated in broad prayer.
Distance from nearness locates the resistant hearer at the far end of the call.
Breadth gives the focus call the reach needed by the acoustic model.

structural_cues: 41:44 combines ear-weight, blindness, calling, place, and distance; 41:51 combines self-distancing, calling, and breadth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both communication geometries; I infer that breadth compensates for self-produced remoteness. The live alternative is that 41:44's remote call is only a simile for incomprehension.

changed_reading.before: Broad prayer means many or lengthy petitions.
changed_reading.after: Broad prayer behaves like long-range transmission from a subject who has placed himself far from receptive relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding cycle says that the human never tires of requesting good, but the same contact with evil cuts off hope twice over. The focus broad prayer therefore coexists with despair: it is not necessarily confident trust but frantic proliferation of appeal after hope has collapsed.

activation_trace.role: Vocal solicitation anchors the focus output whose affective quality is revised.
Weariness from duration or repetition, structurally negated, supplies the unbounded repetition of requests for good.
Repeated solicitation for good supplies the ongoing appetitive phase of the cycle.
Adverse effect reaching the person exactly repeats the focus trigger.
Evil or badness exactly repeats the negative input in the focus.
Cutting off hope supplies the first affective state accompanying adverse contact.
A second image of hope cut off intensifies despair rather than confidence.
Breadth becomes proliferating scale under the affective pressure supplied by 41:49.

structural_cues: 41:49 and 41:51 repeat human, calling, adverse touch, and evil, but assign despair and broad prayer to the shared trigger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an almost exact lexical recurrence; I infer simultaneity or close coupling between despair and broad prayer. A live alternative is a temporal sequence in which despair gives way to renewed hope.

changed_reading.before: Broad prayer displays renewed confidence when trouble arrives.
changed_reading.after: Broad prayer can be frantic verbal expansion inside despair, not evidence that hope remains intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: After harm, mercy is experienced and then verbally reassigned to the self as a possession, while accountability is reduced to conjecture. This supplies a causal form for the focus withdrawal: favor does not merely distract; it is appropriated, severed from its giver, and made evidence of personal entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction anchors the gift whose attribution is at issue.
Merciful tenderness supplies the positive gift arriving after distress.
Loss opposed to benefit supplies the prior adverse state that makes the gift salient.
Articulated speech carries the explicit reassignment of mercy to the self.
Conjecture and uncertainty downgrade accountability while preserving the entitlement claim.
Withdrawal is the embodied result of severing gift from giver.

structural_cues: 41:50 places mercy after harm, then the claim that it belongs to the speaker and a conjectural dismissal of the Hour immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence and self-claim; I infer that appropriation enables the following withdrawal. The live alternative is that the self-claim and focus turning describe adjacent but independent faults.

changed_reading.before: The human forgets the giver once conditions improve.
changed_reading.after: The human actively rewrites received mercy as personal entitlement, and bodily withdrawal enacts that reassignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah names a far schism whose branch field includes an opposing half and deviation toward two sides. It gives the focus side-distance an endpoint: turning and drawing one's side away harden into placement on an opposed side rather than remaining a passing gesture.

activation_trace.role: The bodily side anchors the directional posture that can harden into opposition.
Distancing by one's side supplies the incipient separation.
The opposing half supplies the hardened relational side produced by separation.
Actively creating distance extends the focus gesture into a far condition.

structural_cues: 41:51 locates withdrawal in the side; 41:52 immediately locates rejection in a far schism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent side and schism geometries; I infer progression from gesture to settled opposition. The alternative is that 41:52 changes addressee and does not narrate a progression.

changed_reading.before: Moving one's side away is a temporary sign of arrogance.
changed_reading.after: The side gesture is the bodily seed of a far oppositional placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement spans far horizons and the inward self until truth becomes manifest, then places every thing within complete encompassing knowledge. Against that scale, broad prayer and side-distance cannot solve the focus subject's problem by increasing range. The missing operation is recognition within the self, not more horizontal extension.

activation_trace.role: Breadth and side anchor the focus subject's horizontal strategies of retreat and appeal.
Far horizons supply the outermost horizontal field across which signs are shown.
The self as the thing's own identity supplies the inward field that breadth cannot replace.
Emergence and disclosure supply the recognition toward which outer and inner signs converge.
Complete encompassing in knowledge closes every attempted distance and contains every expanded call.

structural_cues: 41:53 coordinates horizons, selves, and disclosure; 41:54 closes with complete encompassing of every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer range, inner identity, disclosure, and encompassing; I align them as a spatial answer to the focus breadth. The alternative is that عَرِيض only marks verbal abundance and carries no horizon geometry.

changed_reading.before: The subject alternates between moving away and enlarging his plea.
changed_reading.after: Both horizontal strategies remain inside an encompassing field; the deficit is inward recognition, not reach.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare n-u-y image of a rain trench or soil barrier around a tent. It remains anchored in the focus نَأَى and gains material relevance from 41:39's descending water, but downstream prose should present it only as a branch-triggered analogy, never as the direct lexical sense of نَأَى بِجَانِبِهِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَأَى in the focus, read through its packet branch for a rain barrier around a dwelling.

activation_trace.role: A trench or soil barrier around a tent that diverts rain supplies the material image of defensive withdrawal.
Delivered descent supplies the incoming motion that a rain barrier would redirect.
Water delivered by pouring makes the rare protective-earthwork image materially coherent.

changed_reading.before: The human simply steps away when favored.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the human behaves as though building a side berm that diverts a descending gift away from his dwelling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it uses the packet's split d-ayn-ayn mapping for d-ayn-waw. It remains resolvable to the focus دعاء occurrence and coheres with breadth plus repeated solicitation, but it should be rendered as a secondary material image of accumulation, not as an etymological gloss of دعاء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دُعَاءٍ عَرِيضٍ in the focus, using the split mapped branch for agitating a vessel until it is full.

activation_trace.role: Agitating a measure or container until it packs full supplies a material model for a plea filled to capacity.
Breadth supplies the container-like capacity into which repeated appeal accumulates.
Non-weariness under repetition supplies the repeated agitation that fills the broad plea.
The repeated request for good lets the packing image accumulate across the adjacent cycle.

changed_reading.before: Broad prayer means a long or numerous plea.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repeated agitation has packed the plea like a broad vessel filled to capacity.

strongest_changes: The repeated ع ر ض becomes an exchange of breadth: embodied availability is withdrawn in ease and redeployed as expansive speech under harm.
The surah's barrier and distant-call scenes turn prayer into long-range outgoing traffic from a subject resistant to incoming address.
The earth's growth and creation's willing approach expose human withdrawal as a reversal of creaturely response to received good.
The adjacent despair and self-entitlement cycle shows that broad prayer can proliferate without hope and that favor is withdrawn from its giver by reassignment to the self.
The following far schism and final encompassing convert a passing side gesture into opposition while denying that distance or verbal range can escape the field of recognition.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made one bodily-verbal root repetition into a continuous spatial, acoustic, relational, and ecological mechanism without forcing those readings into a single final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: عَرِيض may primarily mark duration, abundance, or rhetorical intensity rather than spatial breadth.
The long-range acoustic model depends on aligning the distant-call comparison in 41:44 with the focus subject's self-distancing.
The cosmic and earth response scenes are strong analogies but do not grammatically state that they judge the focus response.
The rain-berm and packed-vessel readings are deliberately contained branch activations, not direct lexical claims.
